name: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and supply of spherical, mono-disperse particles for various industries and applications worldwide. Its products include chromatography media, solid phase extraction sorbents, particle size standards, magnetic particles, LCD spacers, ACF conductive particles, and various other micro particles. Its products portfolio also includes chromatography resins & pre-packed columns, LCD spacer and conductive particles, silica chromatography, magnetic beads, microspheres for life sciences.
